fonts.door: owner-installed Windows fonts loaded at runtime (owner decision 2, 2026-10-23); otherwise the licensed substitute — any metric difference is reported per typography probe

capture.tool: PowerShell PrintWindow + UI Automation per-window capture (reference agent, 2026-10-26)
capture.method: Per-window PrintWindow at 144 DPI plus element bounds from UI Automation (.uia.tsv); full-screen grabs for shell flyouts; shadows over a white backdrop window (pad 120 px)
capture.permissions: owner decision 2026-10-26: may open apps and flyouts and send navigation hotkeys; no setting changes
capture.privacy: Captures contain the owner name, e-mail, installed apps, notifications and window contents. They stay in the local evidence root; this profile records geometry, colours and hashes only, never personal strings.

Alt+Tab captured with private window thumbnails; Task view and virtual desktops not captured.

No installer or recovery environment in the P14 scope; the reference installer was not run.
